categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Wecome Pharmaceutical Company Limited primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of modern traditional Chinese medicines and Western medicines. Key product categories include antibiotics, heat-clearing and detoxifying drugs, gynecological drugs, and classic Chinese medicine formulas. The company also operated pharmaceutical retail chains until September 2024, which were divested during the reporting period.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced pharmaceutical technologies such as pill-dropping technology for stable drug formulations and soft capsule technology for high bioavailability and precise dosing. It adheres to GMP standards with strict quality control systems covering all stages from raw material procurement to product release. The company has multiple provincial-level research centers and collaborates with Nobel laureates to enhance its R&D capabilities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers include medical institutions such as hospitals and clinics, regional and national chain pharmacies, and end consumers purchasing OTC drugs. The company’s products serve markets focused on respiratory infections, gynecological conditions, digestive health, and chronic diseases. Its products are included in national essential drug lists and medical insurance catalogs, facilitating broad market access.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with significant sales concentrated in the East China and Central China regions. It has established a nationwide marketing network covering multiple provinces and cities. The company’s headquarters and main production facilities are located in Lishui, Zhejiang Province.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang Wecome Pharmaceutical operates primarily in the midstream segment of the pharmaceutical supply chain, focusing on drug R&D, manufacturing, and direct sales to distributors and retail chains. It previously engaged in downstream retail operations but divested these in 2024. The company maintains control over raw material sourcing, production, and distribution logistics.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include advancing core R&D projects on innovative traditional Chinese medicines and improved formulations, expanding product lines with classic formulas, and accelerating clinical trials for new drugs. It aims to increase the inclusion of core products in national medical insurance catalogs and enhance production capacity through modernized facilities. Strengthening the marketing network and talent acquisition are also key focuses to support sustainable growth.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of pharmaceutical products, including prescription and OTC drugs, to medical institutions and retail pharmacies. The company also earns income from investment disposals and government subsidies. Previously, retail sales contributed to revenue but were discontinued in 2024 following divestiture.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a high-tech pharmaceutical enterprise with a strong focus on traditional Chinese medicine innovation. It ranks among the top 100 Chinese traditional medicine companies and holds a competitive position in antibiotic and gynecological drug markets. Major competitors include other domestic pharmaceutical manufacturers specializing in traditional and modern medicines.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 351 million, a 32.41% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 147 million. The decline was influenced by divestiture of retail subsidiaries, reduced product prices, and increased fixed asset depreciation. Despite short-term setbacks, the company continues to invest in R&D and infrastructure to support long-term growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhejiang Wecome Pharmaceutical emphasizes its strong R&D capabilities, patented drug formulations, and adherence to high-quality standards exceeding national pharmacopeia requirements. Its unique pill-dropping and soft capsule technologies enhance drug stability and bioavailability. The company’s inclusion of multiple products in national essential drug and insurance catalogs provides competitive advantages in market access and customer trust.
